//==================== TYPE MelonLoader.CompatibilityLayers.Melon_Resolver ====================
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using MelonLoader.InternalUtils;

namespace MelonLoader.CompatibilityLayers;

internal class Melon_Resolver : MelonCompatibilityLayer.Resolver
{
	private bool is_plugin;

	private Melon_Resolver(Assembly assembly, string filepath)
		: base(assembly, filepath)
	{
	}

	internal static void Setup()
	{
		MelonCompatibilityLayer.AddAssemblyToResolverEvent(GetResolverFromAssembly);
		MelonCompatibilityLayer.AddRefreshPluginsEvent(RefreshPlugins);
		MelonCompatibilityLayer.AddRefreshModsEvent(RefreshMods);
	}

	private static MelonCompatibilityLayer.Resolver GetResolverFromAssembly(Assembly assembly, string filepath)
	{
		IEnumerable<Type> validTypes = assembly.GetValidTypes((Type x) => x.IsSubclassOf(typeof(MelonBase)));
		if (validTypes == null || !validTypes.Any())
		{
			return null;
		}
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filepath))
		{
			filepath = assembly.GetName().Name;
		}
		return new Melon_Resolver(assembly, filepath);
	}

	private static void RefreshPlugins()
	{
		Main.Plugins = MelonHandler.Plugins;
	}

	private static void RefreshMods()
	{
		Main.Mods = MelonHandler.Mods;
	}

	public override void CheckAndCreate(ref List<MelonBase> melonTbl)
	{
		MelonInfoAttribute infoAttribute = null;
		if (!CheckInfoAttribute(ref infoAttribute))
		{
			return;
		}
		List<MelonGameAttribute> gameAttributes = null;
		if (CheckGameAttributes(ref gameAttributes) && CheckProcessAttributes() && CheckGameVersionAttribute() && CheckPlatformAttribute() && CheckPlatformDomainAttribute() && CheckVerifyLoaderVersionAttribute() && CheckVerifyLoaderBuildAttribute())
		{
			MelonColorAttribute melonColorAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonColorAttribute>(Assembly);
			MelonAuthorColorAttribute melonAuthorColorAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonAuthorColorAttribute>(Assembly);
			MelonPriorityAttribute melonPriorityAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonPriorityAttribute>(Assembly, inherit: true);
			MelonIDAttribute melonIDAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonIDAttribute>(Assembly, inherit: true);
			MelonBase melonBase = new MelonCompatibilityLayer.WrapperData
			{
				Assembly = Assembly,
				Info = infoAttribute,
				Games = gameAttributes.ToArray(),
				OptionalDependencies = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonOptionalDependenciesAttribute>(Assembly),
				ConsoleColor = (melonColorAttribute?.Color ?? MelonLogger.DefaultMelonColor),
				AuthorConsoleColor = (melonAuthorColorAttribute?.Color ?? MelonLogger.DefaultTextColor),
				Priority = (melonPriorityAttribute?.Priority ?? 0),
				Location = FilePath,
				ID = melonIDAttribute?.ID
			}.CreateMelon();
			if (melonBase != null)
			{
				melonTbl.Add(melonBase);
			}
		}
	}

	private bool CheckInfoAttribute(ref MelonInfoAttribute infoAttribute)
	{
		infoAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonInfoAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (infoAttribute == null)
		{
			infoAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonModInfoAttribute>(Assembly)?.Convert();
		}
		if (infoAttribute == null)
		{
			infoAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonPluginInfoAttribute>(Assembly)?.Convert();
		}
		if (infoAttribute == null || infoAttribute.SystemType == null)
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("No " + ((infoAttribute == null) ? "MelonInfoAttribute Found" : "Type given to MelonInfoAttribute") + " in " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		is_plugin = infoAttribute.SystemType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(MelonPlugin));
		bool flag = infoAttribute.SystemType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(MelonMod));
		if (!is_plugin && !flag)
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Type Specified " + infoAttribute.SystemType.AssemblyQualifiedName + " is not a Subclass of MelonPlugin or MelonMod in " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		bool flag2 = string.IsNullOrEmpty(infoAttribute.Name);
		bool flag3 = string.IsNullOrEmpty(infoAttribute.Version);
		if (flag2 | flag3)
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("No " + (flag2 ? "Name" : (flag3 ? "Version" : "")) + " given to MelonInfoAttribute in " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		if (is_plugin ? MelonHandler.IsPluginAlreadyLoaded(infoAttribute.Name) : MelonHandler.IsModAlreadyLoaded(infoAttribute.Name))
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Duplicate " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + " " + infoAttribute.Name + ": " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckGameAttributes(ref List<MelonGameAttribute> gameAttributes)
	{
		gameAttributes = new List<MelonGameAttribute>();
		MelonGameAttribute[] array = MelonUtils.PullAttributesFromAssembly<MelonGameAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
		{
			gameAttributes.AddRange(array);
		}
		MelonModGameAttribute[] array2 = MelonUtils.PullAttributesFromAssembly<MelonModGameAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (array2 != null && array2.Length != 0)
		{
			MelonModGameAttribute[] array3 = array2;
			foreach (MelonModGameAttribute melonModGameAttribute in array3)
			{
				gameAttributes.Add(melonModGameAttribute.Convert());
			}
		}
		MelonPluginGameAttribute[] array4 = MelonUtils.PullAttributesFromAssembly<MelonPluginGameAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (array4 != null && array4.Length != 0)
		{
			MelonPluginGameAttribute[] array5 = array4;
			foreach (MelonPluginGameAttribute melonPluginGameAttribute in array5)
			{
				gameAttributes.Add(melonPluginGameAttribute.Convert());
			}
		}
		if (!MelonUtils.CurrentGameAttribute.Universal && gameAttributes.Count > 0)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			for (int j = 0; j < gameAttributes.Count; j++)
			{
				MelonGameAttribute melonGameAttribute = gameAttributes[j];
				if (melonGameAttribute != null && (melonGameAttribute.Universal || MelonUtils.CurrentGameAttribute.IsCompatible(melonGameAttribute)))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible Game for " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + ": " + FilePath);
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckProcessAttributes()
	{
		List<MelonProcessAttribute> list = MelonUtils.PullAttributesFromAssembly<MelonProcessAttribute>(Assembly).ToList();
		if (list.Count <= 0)
		{
			return true;
		}
		string fileName = Process.GetCurrentProcess().MainModule.FileName;
		string fileName2 = Path.GetFileName(fileName);
		string fileNameWithoutExtension = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fileName);
		bool flag = false;
		for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
		{
			MelonProcessAttribute melonProcessAttribute = list[i];
			if (melonProcessAttribute != null && (melonProcessAttribute.Universal || fileName2.Equals(melonProcessAttribute.EXE_Name) || fileNameWithoutExtension.Equals(melonProcessAttribute.EXE_Name)))
			{
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible Process Executable for " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + ": " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckGameVersionAttribute()
	{
		if (!is_plugin)
		{
			return true;
		}
		List<MelonGameVersionAttribute> list = MelonUtils.PullAttributesFromAssembly<MelonGameVersionAttribute>(Assembly).ToList();
		if (list.Count <= 0)
		{
			return true;
		}
		bool flag = false;
		for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
		{
			MelonGameVersionAttribute melonGameVersionAttribute = list[i];
			if (melonGameVersionAttribute != null && (melonGameVersionAttribute.Universal || UnityInformationHandler.GameVersion == melonGameVersionAttribute.Version))
			{
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible Game Version for Mod: " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckPlatformAttribute()
	{
		MelonPlatformAttribute melonPlatformAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonPlatformAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (melonPlatformAttribute == null || melonPlatformAttribute.Platforms == null || melonPlatformAttribute.Platforms.Length == 0)
		{
			return true;
		}
		bool flag = false;
		for (int i = 0; i < melonPlatformAttribute.Platforms.Length; i++)
		{
			MelonPlatformAttribute.CompatiblePlatforms compatiblePlatforms = melonPlatformAttribute.Platforms[i];
			if (compatiblePlatforms == MelonPlatformAttribute.CompatiblePlatforms.UNIVERSAL || (MelonUtils.IsGame32Bit() && compatiblePlatforms == MelonPlatformAttribute.CompatiblePlatforms.WINDOWS_X86) || (!MelonUtils.IsGame32Bit() && compatiblePlatforms == MelonPlatformAttribute.CompatiblePlatforms.WINDOWS_X64))
			{
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible Platform for " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + ": " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckPlatformDomainAttribute()
	{
		MelonPlatformDomainAttribute melonPlatformDomainAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<MelonPlatformDomainAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (melonPlatformDomainAttribute == null || melonPlatformDomainAttribute.Domain == MelonPlatformDomainAttribute.CompatibleDomains.UNIVERSAL)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (!(MelonUtils.IsGameIl2Cpp() ? (melonPlatformDomainAttribute.Domain == MelonPlatformDomainAttribute.CompatibleDomains.IL2CPP) : (melonPlatformDomainAttribute.Domain == MelonPlatformDomainAttribute.CompatibleDomains.MONO)))
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible Platform Domain for " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + ": " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckVerifyLoaderVersionAttribute()
	{
		VerifyLoaderVersionAttribute verifyLoaderVersionAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<VerifyLoaderVersionAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (verifyLoaderVersionAttribute == null)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (!(verifyLoaderVersionAttribute.IsMinimum ? (verifyLoaderVersionAttribute.SemVer <= "0.5.4") : (verifyLoaderVersionAttribute.SemVer == "0.5.4")))
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible MelonLoader Version for " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + ": " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckVerifyLoaderBuildAttribute()
	{
		VerifyLoaderBuildAttribute verifyLoaderBuildAttribute = MelonUtils.PullAttributeFromAssembly<VerifyLoaderBuildAttribute>(Assembly);
		if (verifyLoaderBuildAttribute == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(verifyLoaderBuildAttribute.HashCode))
		{
			return true;
		}
		string hashCode = MelonUtils.HashCode;
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(hashCode))
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (!hashCode.Equals(verifyLoaderBuildAttribute.HashCode))
		{
			MelonLogger.Error("Incompatible MelonLoader Build for " + (is_plugin ? "Plugin" : "Mod") + ": " + FilePath);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
}


//==================== TYPE MelonLoader.Assertions.LemonAssert ====================
using System;

namespace MelonLoader.Assertions;

public static class LemonAssert
{
	private static void Failure(string exceptionMsg, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(exceptionMsg))
		{
			exceptionMsg = "Assertion has failed!";
		}
		LemonAssertException ex = new LemonAssertException(exceptionMsg, userMessage);
		if (shouldThrowException)
		{
			throw ex;
		}
		MelonLogger.Error(ex);
	}

	public static void IsNull<T>(T obj)
	{
		IsNull(obj, null, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsNull<T>(T obj, string userMessage)
	{
		IsNull(obj, userMessage, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsNull<T>(T obj, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		bool flag = false;
		Delegate value2;
		if (LemonAssertMapping.IsNull.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
		{
			flag = (bool)value.DynamicInvoke(obj);
		}
		else if (LemonAssertMapping.IsNull.TryGetValue(typeof(object), out value2))
		{
			flag = (bool)value2.DynamicInvoke(obj);
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			Failure(NullFailureMessage(expectedResult: true), userMessage, shouldThrowException);
		}
	}

	public static void IsNotNull<T>(T obj)
	{
		IsNotNull(obj, null, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsNotNull<T>(T obj, string userMessage)
	{
		IsNotNull(obj, userMessage, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsNotNull<T>(T obj, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		bool flag = false;
		Delegate value2;
		if (LemonAssertMapping.IsNull.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
		{
			flag = (bool)value.DynamicInvoke(obj);
		}
		else if (LemonAssertMapping.IsNull.TryGetValue(typeof(object), out value2))
		{
			flag = (bool)value2.DynamicInvoke(obj);
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			Failure(NullFailureMessage(expectedResult: false), userMessage, shouldThrowException);
		}
	}

	public static void IsFalse(bool obj)
	{
		IsFalse(obj, null, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsFalse(bool obj, string userMessage)
	{
		IsFalse(obj, userMessage, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsFalse(bool obj, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		if (obj)
		{
			Failure(BooleanFailureMessage(expectedResult: false), userMessage, shouldThrowException);
		}
	}

	public static void IsTrue(bool obj)
	{
		IsTrue(obj, null, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsTrue(bool obj, string userMessage)
	{
		IsTrue(obj, userMessage, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsTrue(bool obj, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		if (!obj)
		{
			Failure(BooleanFailureMessage(expectedResult: true), userMessage, shouldThrowException);
		}
	}

	public static void IsEqual<T>(T obj, T obj2)
	{
		IsEqual(obj, obj2, null, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsEqual<T>(T obj, T obj2, string userMessage)
	{
		IsEqual(obj, obj2, userMessage, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsEqual<T>(T obj, T obj2, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		bool flag = false;
		Delegate value2;
		if (LemonAssertMapping.IsEqual.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
		{
			flag = (bool)value.DynamicInvoke(obj, obj2);
		}
		else if (LemonAssertMapping.IsEqual.TryGetValue(typeof(object), out value2))
		{
			flag = (bool)value2.DynamicInvoke(obj, obj2);
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			Failure(EqualityFailureMessage(obj, obj2, expectedResult: true), userMessage, shouldThrowException);
		}
	}

	public static void IsNotEqual<T>(T obj, T obj2)
	{
		IsNotEqual(obj, obj2, null, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsNotEqual<T>(T obj, T obj2, string userMessage)
	{
		IsNotEqual(obj, obj2, userMessage, shouldThrowException: true);
	}

	public static void IsNotEqual<T>(T obj, T obj2, string userMessage, bool shouldThrowException)
	{
		bool flag = false;
		Delegate value2;
		if (LemonAssertMapping.IsEqual.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
		{
			flag = (bool)value.DynamicInvoke(obj, obj2);
		}
		else if (LemonAssertMapping.IsEqual.TryGetValue(typeof(object), out value2))
		{
			flag = (bool)value2.DynamicInvoke(obj, obj2);
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			Failure(EqualityFailureMessage(obj, obj2, expectedResult: false), userMessage, shouldThrowException);
		}
	}

	private static string GetFailureMessage(string result, string expected)
	{
		return "Assertion failure! " + result + "\nExpected: " + expected;
	}

	private static string NullFailureMessage(bool expectedResult)
	{
		string result = "Value was " + (expectedResult ? "not " : "") + "Null";
		string expected = "Value was " + ((!expectedResult) ? "not " : "") + "Null";
		return GetFailureMessage(result, expected);
	}

	private static string BooleanFailureMessage(bool expectedResult)
	{
		string result = $"Value was {!expectedResult}";
		string expected = $"Value was {expectedResult}";
		return GetFailureMessage(result, expected);
	}

	private static string EqualityFailureMessage(object obj, object obj2, bool expectedResult)
	{
		string result = string.Format("{0} {1} {2}", obj, (!expectedResult) ? "==" : "!=", obj2);
		string expected = string.Format("{0} {1} {2}", obj, expectedResult ? "==" : "!=", obj2);
		return GetFailureMessage(result, expected);
	}
}


//==================== TYPE MelonLoader.Assertions.LemonAssertException ====================
using System;

namespace MelonLoader.Assertions;

public class LemonAssertException : Exception
{
	private string UserMessage;

	public override string Message
	{
		get
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserMessage))
			{
				return base.Message + "\n" + UserMessage;
			}
			return base.Message;
		}
	}

	public LemonAssertException(string exceptionMsg, string userMessage)
		: base(exceptionMsg)
	{
		UserMessage = userMessage;
	}
}


//==================== TYPE MelonLoader.Assertions.LemonAssertMapping ====================
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace MelonLoader.Assertions;

public static class LemonAssertMapping
{
	internal static Dictionary<Type, Delegate> IsNull = new Dictionary<Type, Delegate>();

	internal static Dictionary<Type, Delegate> IsEqual = new Dictionary<Type, Delegate>();

	internal static void Setup()
	{
		Register_IsNull<object>(IsNull_object);
		Register_IsNull<string>(IsNull_string);
		Register_IsEqual<object>(IsEqual_object);
	}

	public static void Register_IsNull<T>(Func<T, bool> method)
	{
		Register<T>(method, ref IsNull);
	}

	public static void Register_IsEqual<T>(Func<T, T, bool> method)
	{
		Register<T>(method, ref IsEqual);
	}

	private static void Register<T>(Delegate method, ref Dictionary<Type, Delegate> tbl)
	{
		if ((object)method == null)
		{
			throw new NullReferenceException("method");
		}
		Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
		if (tbl.ContainsKey(typeFromHandle))
		{
			return;
		}
		lock (tbl)
		{
			tbl[typeFromHandle] = method;
		}
	}

	private static bool IsNull_object(object obj)
	{
		return obj == null;
	}

	private static bool IsNull_string(string obj)
	{
		return string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj);
	}

	private static bool IsEqual_object(object obj, object obj2)
	{
		if (obj == null)
		{
			return obj2 == null;
		}
		if (obj2 == null)
		{
			return obj == null;
		}
		return obj.Equals(obj2);
	}
}
